title: Design a separate history for Athena's records
summary: Write docs/design/records-history.md, a design-only document covering all seven required points for moving Athena's records into their own history, and add a Proposed entry to docs/decisions.md for Sri to decide. CHANGELOG.md may also get an entry. No code or configuration changes.

defaults_applied.how: The deliverable is the written design with alternatives, proposed for review before anything is built.
Claims cite BRIEF.md, athena.toml and measured figures, with estimates labeled.
Two docs files plus the changelog entry; no code.
Criteria check the design's content and the diff, not file existence.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: a design Sri can decide on; audience is Sri and the verifier judging the document.
Design only; no athena.toml change even though the [history] exemptions would later change, which the design describes.
CHANGELOG.md may get an entry per the changelog default.
Recommendation is the producer's judgment from the repository; the reading does not presuppose which option.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/design/records-history.md compares at least three options (records branch with a separate root in this repo, a second repository, a database), each weighed against BRIEF.md A4, A5 and D72, and recommends exactly one with reasons.

The design migrates every existing record, states what happens to records/ on main afterwards, and how the history check treats commits before the cutover (including the six [history] exempt entries and 02837e0).

The design attributes each main commit from records alone, with no commit-message trailers: it names the records written after the merge (PR head, host-made commit), gives the pull-request-level squash rule, and says how PR commits stay reachable without the host.
A table lists each current guarantee (append-only, nothing unverified reaches main, prediction precedes outcome, secrets and personal data) with where it is enforced after the change.
The design covers crash reconciliation between host merge and record write, and parallel writers to the records history.
The design makes the check's cost depend only on commits new since the last passing state, with a periodic full replay, and says how this is measured against today's ~65 s / ~4,000 records.
The design gives an ordered build plan of jobs, each sized for one producer run, in which main is never unattributed, and states the reversal cost.
docs/decisions.md has a new entry with status Proposed (not Accepted) summarising recommendation and alternatives, in the file's existing format and numbering; no existing entry is altered.

No code or governance files change: run git diff --stat and confirm it lists only docs/design/records-history.md, docs/decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md (no athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflow or Rust files).

out_of_scope: Any code, tests, or implementation of the records history
Changes to athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows, or the [history] exempt entries
Accepting the decision: the entry stays Proposed
Moving or rewriting any existing records
departures: Long, multi-part design document with seven required points raises cost and verification risk slightly above the reference.
